weakness: Portal accounts that can change treatment setpoints sign in with a password only
source: P07 assessment (IA-02(01)); P03 G-027; P01 R-001
remediation_plan: Turn on app-based MFA for every portal account; new unique passphrase; remove the saved password from the phone app
milestones: 2026-09-15 MFA on and tested from a new browser

weakness: Integrator remote access always enabled, unapproved, password only, and unlogged by the owner
source: P07 assessment (MA-04 objectives); P03 G-028 and G-037; P01 R-002
remediation_plan: Disable the integrator account between owner-approved sessions; MFA on the account; maintenance log; ask about the 2 unexplained sessions; add remote access, 24-hour incident notice, and program-copy terms to the agreement
milestones: 2026-09-15 account disabled and log started; 2026-10-31 agreement terms signed
resources_required: Owner time; possible legal review of the agreement (about $300)

weakness: No remote access rules; router remote web administration was on
source: P07 assessment (AC-17 objectives); P03 G-030; P01 R-003
remediation_plan: Keep remote administration off (turned off 2026-07-23); POL-01 section 6 rules; record required router settings; firmware update
milestones: 2026-09-15 router settings recorded and firmware updated
resources_required: Owner time; integrator visit shared with POAM-004

weakness: Default, shared, reused, and saved passwords on the treatment control path
source: P07 assessment (IA-05 objectives); P03 G-026; P01 R-001 and R-013
remediation_plan: Password manager; named portal account for the relief operator; replace the router password now; change PLC and HMI default passwords and add an HMI login with the integrator
milestones: 2026-09-15 password manager and router password; 2026-11-30 PLC and HMI passwords changed during the integrator visit
resources_required: Password manager about $40 a year; integrator visit about $600

weakness: No owner-held copy of the PLC program and HMI project; residual spreadsheet only on the laptop
source: P07 assessment (CP-09 objectives); P03 G-015 and G-029; P01 R-004 and R-014
remediation_plan: Two copies of the current program (encrypted USB in the fire safe; file account); spreadsheet moved to the file account; restore steps written with the integrator
resources_required: Encrypted USB drive about $40; integrator time

weakness: Portal sign-ins and setpoint changes never reviewed
remediation_plan: Monthly review on the first of each month and after any alarm without a known cause; note each review in the operating log

weakness: No reporting times or cyber contacts; Ground Water Rule next-business-day clock unknown
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 G-005 and G-014; P01 R-008
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; add reporting times to the relief and integrator agreements; walk through with the relief operator
milestones: 2026-09-30 contact sheet in the well house binder and walkthrough done

weakness: No review or update cycle for the risk assessment
remediation_plan: POL-01 4.3 sets an annual July review and change triggers; first update July 2027
